description: This file provides extension methods for handling generic type strings, including parsing, constructing, and deconstructing generic types, mainly in the context of Orleans grain types and type system manipulation.

classes.name: TypeConverterExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for working with string representations of generic types within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: IsGenericType
methods.description: Checks if the provided type string denotes a generic type by searching for the '`' character.

methods.name: GetGenericTypeArity
methods.description: Extracts the number of generic parameters (arity) from a type string, throwing an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: IsConstructed
methods.description: Determines whether the type string represents a constructed generic type by searching for the '[' character.

methods.name: GetDeconstructed
methods.description: Returns the base type string without its generic arguments.

methods.name: GetConstructed
methods.description: Generates a constructed generic type string from an unconstructed type and specified type arguments.

methods.name: GetConstructed
methods.description: Constructs a generic grain type using type arguments from a corresponding generic interface type.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Extracts the type argument list from a constructed generic type string.
